title: Deep-Tremor Ear
text: Deep-Tremor Ear listens through the road with a fan of bone and snaps at the loudest heartbeat. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: It has never seen daylight, but it knows where you stand.

defeatReward.text: Deep-Tremor Ear is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
